The '''Felin system''' was a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Spinward sector/Legends|Spinward sector]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Felin [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-2.<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|species=[[Felinian]]|system=Felin [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Felinian]] [[Species/Legends|species]], which was introduced in "[[Limping Lady (article)|Limping Lady]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and published in the [[September]] [[1992]] [[Challenge 64|sixty-fourth issue]] of the [[Challenge (magazine)|''Challenge'']] magazine for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="LimpingLady">{{ChallengeCite|64|Limping Lady (article)}}</ref> The adventure is considered [[Canon|noncanonical]] with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Unlicensed">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref>
